build: Apex disk release, the contributor's own G64 images of both sides; sha256 of each in orientation.md

comments.text: The ending file's entry, reached by JMP $5A00 from the engine's loader ($CE63) once file CF has loaded. Jumps to the set-up at $5A52.
Calls the music driver's frame entry $087B (JMP, so the driver's RTS returns to the caller). Called once a frame from the raster handler $5B96 (at $5BAC).
A lone RTS after the two jumps; nothing in the ending calls it (no reference found).

Leaves the ending when fire is pressed on "the end" (JMP from $5B72): interrupts off, stack reset to $FF, the screen blanked (clears bit 4 of $D011), then JMP $C019 in the engine, which jumps to $CE66: swap $D800-$DFFF with $7800-$7FFF and start a new game from the first land at $CBA5. The ending never returns to the intro.
Colour cycle enable after the end: 0 as loaded, set to 1 by $5EA5 when sprites 6 and 7 have finished moving apart; read by $5BC9, which then runs $6001.

0 during the credits; set to 1 by $5B55 when the top strip has run out of map with no strip set left ($5A18 = 0). Read by the main loop ($5B39, $5B66: fire then restarts) and the line-$FA handler ($5B96, $5BAF: switches to the "the end" frame work).
1 as loaded: more strip sets are waiting to be copied in. Cleared by $5FFC once $5A28 reaches 4. Read by the main loop at $5B4E.
Bytes of the text buffers still to fill with $8F: $A0 as loaded and set to $A0 by $5F2A at each page change; $5F6B counts it down by 80 a call. The set-up loop at $5AB7 waits for 0.
Next text fragment to print (0-72), stepped by $5D8C; compared with the line's end $5A20.
Set by $5F99 when a page's printing starts; $5D57 then fetches line 1's end and points the printer at buffer $68B3, and clears it ($5D6D).
Set by $5F9C; when line 1 is done, $5D97 sees it, clears it and starts line 2 ($5A1D).
Set by $5DAC; $5D72 then fetches line 2's end and points the printer at buffer $6903, and clears it ($5D83).
Written 1 at $5DAF when line 2 starts and 0 at $5DA1 when printing stops; nothing reads it.
Index into the line-end table $652B, stepped by $5DB3: 0-17 over the credits.
The fragment index that ends the line being printed ($652B entry), set by $5DB3, compared at $5D92.
1 while a page's text is being printed into the buffers (set by $5F96, cleared by $5DA1); 1 as loaded, so page 0 prints during the set-up loop at $5ABC.
Set by $60CB when the top strip has finished its map; the main loop ($5B49) then copies the next set; cleared by $5FD8 after the 16th block.
Frames to wait after the text hold is released before the shutters close: $FF as loaded and set to $FF by $5F20; counted down by $5EB8.
Column of buffer $6903/$692B that credit line 2's scroll puts on screen next: $27 from $5F91, counted down by $634A to the zero terminator at $6903.
The credit page showing, 0-8; stepped by $5ED5 at each page change, which stops at 8.
Block of the strip set being copied, 0-15 ($5FA0), the index into the length and destination tables.
Source block, 0-63 over all four sets ($5FA0): the index into the source tables $6964/$69A4.
Strip sets copied in so far, stepped by $5DFB; at 4, $5FF6 clears $5A18.
1 holds the page: no text scroll-in ($5B84) and no page change ($5EAE). 1 as loaded; cleared by $5A44 when the page timer fires, set again by $5F25 when the shutters have opened on a new page.
Two bytes no instruction in the ending reads or writes (0 as loaded).
Credit band fade counter, loaded with 8 from $67CB by $5A39 and counted down by $62AB until it goes negative; indexes the fade steps at $67B9/$67C2.
Portrait colour fade counter, loaded with 8 from $680D by $5A3F and counted down by $62C7; indexes the fade steps at $67FB/$6804.
Column of buffer $68B3/$68DB that credit line 1's scroll puts on screen next: 0 from $5F8C, stepped by $631E up to the zero at $68DA.
Set to 1 by the raster handlers $5BF2 (credits) and $5BBB (after the end); the main loop at $5B31 waits for it and decrements it.
Toggled by the main loop each pass ($5B5E); the fades, the page timer and sprites 6/7 run only on one parity.

Starts a credit page's colour fade when the text hold flag $5A29 is set: copies the fade lengths $67CB and $680D (8) into the counters $5A2C and $5A2D, clears $5A29 (releasing the text scroll-in and the page change at $5EAE) and colours the six cells of screen row 14 at $DA41-$DA46 brown (9). Called by the page timer $5D36.
The engine reads $5A32/$5A34 of a land file ($E6AE); in the ending they are operand bytes of this code and the engine never reads them here.

Set-up of the ending, run once. Interrupts off, $01 = $35, the NMI vector's low byte $0318 = $C1 as the engine's start-up does at $197F; VIC bank 1 ($DD00 bits 0-1 = %10); $D018 (see the side comment at $5A73); CIA 1 port A output, B input, both $7F; border and background black; frame flag $5A2F = 0. Sprite set 0 ($5DFF), colour RAM all black ($5CF4), screen $4400 filled with char $8F ($5D08), multicolour text ($62A2), page 0's band colours ($5DC0) and portrait ($5E5C). Then clears the text buffers ($5F6B until $5A19 = 0) and prints page 0's two lines into them ($5D57 until $5A21 = 0), draws the 6 x 5 portrait frame from $6A04 at rows 10-14, columns 17-22 with its colours, builds sprite images $20 (solid, $4800) and $21 (empty, $4840), starts the ending tune at $6CEE ($080C, X = high, Y = low), clears extended colour mode, installs the raster chain at $5B78 ($5D29, then $5C75 with $01 = $36, KERNAL in) and falls into the main loop $5B31.

AND $E0 is the zero-page address $E0, not AND #$E0; $E0 holds 0 in both snapshots, so this writes 0 to $D018 until the raster handlers write $1F/$1D. Harmless: the handlers $5BF2 and $5C4A set $D018 every frame.

Main loop. Waits for the frame flag $5A2F (set by the raster handlers $5BF2 / $5BBB) and decrements it. While the ending is not finished ($5A17 = 0): scrolls the bottom strip ($617D) and the top strip ($604A), border black, and when the top strip has finished its map ($5A22) either copies the next land's strip graphics a block a frame ($5FA0) while sets remain ($5A18), or, after the fifth set, sets $5A17 = 1: "the end". Toggles the frame parity $5A30. Once finished, fire on joystick port 2 ($DC00 bit 4 = 0) leaves through $5A07.

Raster handler at line $CA (the first at $F9): runs the credit page animation - page changes with their shutters ($5EAE), page 0's first shutter opening ($5F50), text buffer clearing ($5F6B), text printing ($5D57), and while the text hold $5A29 is clear, scrolls the two credit lines in ($62F4 from the right, $6322 from the left). Next: line $FA, $5B96.

Raster handler at line $FA. Before the end ($5A17 = 0): top strip's fine X scroll ($D016 = $D0 OR $6044: multicolour, 38 columns), the band and portrait colour fades ($62AB, $62C7) and the page timer ($5D36). Always: music ($5A03). Next: line $61, $5BF2 before the end; after it, goes on at $5BBB.

The part of the line-$FA handler that runs after the end ($5A17 = 1): the one-shot "the end" steps ($6474), the blinking sprites ($6439), the curtain sprites ($5E82), background black, the colour cycle once the curtain is open ($6001 when $5A16 is set) with sprites 6 and 7 coloured from $676A, then sets the frame flag $5A2F. Next: line $B9, $5BE6.
Raster handler at line $B9 after the end: background $0B (dark grey) for the lower part of the screen. Next: line $FA, $5B96.

Raster handler at line $61, just below the top strip: waits in the NOP slide ($602D), switches to the credits charset at $7800 ($D018 = $1F), hires, 40 columns, no X scroll, background white (1), and sets the frame flag $5A2F. Next: line $7D, $5C18.

Raster handler at line $7D: the credit band's colours, $D021 and multicolours $D022/$D023 (the immediates at $5C19, $5C1E, $5C23, set per page by $5DC0 and faded by $62AB), and turns the shutter sprites 0 and 1 solid (pointer $20). Next: line $AD, $5C36.
Immediate of LDA: the credit band's background ($D021), written by $5DDA from the page and fade triples.
Immediate of LDA: the credit band's multicolour 1 ($D022), written by $5DD4.
Immediate of LDA: the credit band's multicolour 2 ($D023), written by $5DCE.
Raster handler at line $AD: background white (1) and shutter sprites 0 and 1 empty (pointer $21), so the shutters show only between lines $7D and $AC. Next: line $C5, $5C4A.

Raster handler at line $C5: NOP-slide delay ($6033), background (immediate at $5C4E, per land set from $5DDE), bottom strip's fine X scroll ($D016 = $D0 OR $6045), strip charset $7000 ($D018 = $1D), multicolours $D022/$D023 (immediates at $5C65/$5C6A, per land set). Next: line $CA, $5B78.
Immediate of LDA: the bottom strip's background ($D021), written per strip set by $5DF8.
Immediate of LDA: the strips' multicolour 1 ($D022), written per strip set by $5DF2.
Immediate of LDA: the strips' multicolour 2 ($D023), written per strip set by $5DEC.

Installs the ending's raster interrupt, as the engine's $1809 does: A to $01, X/Y (first handler) into the JSR at $5CE1; carry clear points $0314 and $FFFE at $5CD4, carry set at $5CCE; puts the immediates at $5CA6/$5CAB into the exit jump $5CEE/$5CEF; CIA interrupts off and acknowledged; raster interrupt on at line $F9; CIA 1 timer A stopped.
the immediates at $5CA6/$5CAB become the exit jump's address; $5D29 and $5D18 rewrite them.
Immediate of LDA: low byte stored into the exit jump at $5CEE by $5C75; $7E as loaded ($5D29), $23 from $5D18.
Immediate of LDA: high byte stored into the exit jump at $5CEF by $5C75; $EA as loaded ($5D29), $5D from $5D18.
Raster interrupt entry for the KERNAL-out case (carry set at $5C75): saves A, X, Y itself and falls into $5CD4. The ending installs with carry clear, so this is unused.

Raster interrupt dispatcher. If the VIC raised it: acknowledges, calls the handler in the JSR at $5CE1, writes the A it returns to $D012 and the X/Y it returns back into that JSR. Leaves by JMP $EA7E (KERNAL register restore), or $5D23 when $5D18 has patched it.
Operand of the dispatcher's JSR: low byte of the current raster handler, written by $5C78 and by $5CE7 from the X each handler returns.
Operand of the dispatcher's JSR: high byte of the current raster handler, written by $5C7B and $5CEA from Y.
Operand of the dispatcher's exit JMP, low byte ($7E: KERNAL $EA7E), written by $5CA7.
Operand of the dispatcher's exit JMP, high byte, written by $5CAC.
X = $FB, A = 8, then falls into $5CF4: colour RAM all orange. Called from $6486 when "the end" begins.
Fills colour RAM $D800-$DBE7 with A, X = $FB down to 1 (four stripes of 250).
X = $FB, A = $8F, then falls into $5D08: fills the screen at $4400 with char $8F. Called from $6493.
Fills the screen $4400-$47E7 with A, X = $FB down to 1 (four stripes of 250).
Points the dispatcher's exit jump at $5D23 (own register restore) for a later $5C75. Nothing in the ending calls it.
Pulls Y, X, A and returns from the interrupt: the exit used with the KERNAL out. Reached only if $5D18 has run.
Points the dispatcher's exit jump at $EA7E, the KERNAL's register restore, for the next $5C75.
Page timer, inner count: $FA as loaded, reloaded with $EB by $5D44; counted down by $5D3F.
Page timer, outer count: 1 as loaded, reloaded with 4 by $5D4E; counted down by $5D49.

Credit page timer, run each frame by $5B96 while its enable (immediate at $5D37, 1 as loaded; $5ED1 writes 1 again after the last page) is set, counting on even frames ($5A30 = 0): $5D34 counts $EB frames ($FA the first time), $5D35 counts those 4 times (once the first time), then $5A31 starts the next fade-in and releases the text hold.
Immediate of LDA at $5D36: non-zero runs the page timer. 1 as loaded, and the only write ($5ED1, on the last page) stores 1 again, so the timer always runs.

While printing ($5A21): at the start of line 1 ($5A1B) or line 2 ($5A1D) fetches the line's last fragment from $652B ($5DB3) and points the printer at buffer $68B3 or $6903 ($6358); prints fragment $5A1A ($635F) and steps it. At the line's end switches to line 2 if $5A1C is set, else stops ($5A21 = 0). One fragment a call, so one a frame.
$5A20 = $652B[$5A1F], the fragment index that ends the next line; steps $5A1F.

Y = page (0-8): copies the three bytes at ($6783/$678C)[Y] into the immediates at $5C19, $5C1E, $5C23, the credit band's $D021/$D022/$D023 (handler $5C18). Its tail $5DCA is shared with the fade step $62AB.
Y = land set (0-3): copies the three bytes at ($67E7/$67EB)[Y] into the immediates at $5C4E, $5C65, $5C6A (the bottom strip's $D021/$D022/$D023, handler $5C4A) and steps the sets-shown count $5A28.

Y = 0 (credits) or 1 (the end): from the 40-byte record at ($6856/$6858)[Y], read from its last byte down, loads the 8 sprite pointers ($47F8), positions $D000-$D00F, colours $D027-$D02E, $D026, $D025, enable $D015, Y expand $D017, X expand $D01D, multicolour $D01C, X high bits $D010 and priority $D01B.
Y = page (0-8): sprite 2's pointer from $68AA[Y] (the page's portrait), and its multicolours $D025, $D026 and colour $D029 from the triple at ($6829/$6832)[Y].
1 as loaded: $5E82 moves sprites 6 and 7 apart after the end; cleared by $5EA0 when sprite 6 reaches Y = $68.
$C8 as loaded: odd frames $5E82 waits before moving sprites 6 and 7; counted down by $5EA9.

After the end, on odd frames: waits $5E81 frames (200), then moves sprite 6 up and sprite 7 down a line a frame until sprite 6 is at Y = $68; then stops ($5E80 = 0) and turns on the colour cycle ($5A16 = 1).
0 while the shutters close (or wait), 1 while they open on a new page: set by $5EF4, cleared by $5F2F; read by $5EBC.

The credit page change, each frame. Idle while the text hold $5A29 is set; then waits $5A23 frames. Closing: moves sprite 0 right and sprite 1 left a pixel a frame (from the parked X $70 and $D0) until sprite 0's X is $90. Then, unless page 8 (the last) is showing (it writes 1 to the page timer's enable $5D37 and returns, so the pages stop there), steps the page $5A25 and sets its band colours ($5DC0), row 14's colour ($67B0) and portrait ($5E5C), and opens: shutters unexpanded at X $A0, sprite 1 at Y $97, then sprite 0 moving up and sprite 1 down a line a frame until sprite 0's Y is $6C. Open ($5F1E): re-arms the hold ($5A29 = 1, $5A23 = $FF), asks for the text buffers to be cleared ($5A19 = $A0) and parks the shutters ($5F32).
$FF as loaded: frames $5F50 waits before page 0's shutters open; counted down by $5F59, never reloaded.

Opens the shutters over page 0's portrait. Runs while its enable (the immediate at $5F51, 1 as loaded) is non-zero: waits $5F4F frames (255), then each frame moves sprite 0 up and sprite 1 down a line until sprite 0's Y is $6C, then parks them at $5F32 (Y-expanded at X $70 and $D0, Y $82), which writes 0 to the enable, so it runs once.
Immediate of LDA at $5F50: 1 as loaded runs page 0's shutter opening; $5F34 writes 0 when the shutters are parked, and the BEQ at $5F52 then returns at once.

While $5A19 is non-zero, fills 80 bytes a call with char $8F, from $68B3 + $5A19 downward (so $68B4-$6953: one byte past the buffers, and never $68B3). When done: zero terminators at $68DA and $6903, scroll indices $5A2E = 0 and $5A24 = $27, and starts printing ($5A21, $5A1B, $5A1C = 1).

Copies one block of the next land's strip graphics a frame: source ($6964/$69A4)[$5A27] + 1, destination ($69E4/$69F4)[$5A26] + 1, length $6954[$5A26] (0 = 256), copied from the top down. After 16 blocks: the colour of char $8F ($6AB1) = 0, the strips restart (top column $6048 = 1, bottom $6049 = $FF, speed $6043 = 1, $5A22 = 0) with the new set's colours ($5DDE); after the fourth set, $5A18 = 0.
Counts the colour cycle's calls down from 3 ($6001, reloaded by $6008): the 16 colours rotate every third frame.
Every third call ($6000 counts 3), rotates the 16 colours at $676A-$6779 one place (first to last). Sprites 6 and 7 take $676A each frame ($5BD1).
14 NOPs ($EA) ahead of the slide's first entry $602D; no jump lands in them, so they never run.
NOP slide used as a raster delay: $5BF2 enters at $602D (21 NOPs), $5C4A at $6033 (15 NOPs), both ending at the RTS at $6042.
The NOP slide entered six NOPs later, by the bottom-strip handler $5C4A: 15 NOPs and the RTS, a shorter delay than $602D.
Strip scroll speed in pixels a frame: 1 as loaded and set to 1 by $5FEA; 0 from $60C6 while a new set is copied.
Top strip's fine X scroll, 0-7: lowered by the speed in $604A, put in $D016 by $5B9D.
Bottom strip's fine X scroll, 0-7: raised by the speed in $617D, put in $D016 by $5C54.
Repeats left of the top strip's current map loop ($60EA-$60F7).
Repeats left of the bottom strip's current map loop ($6213-$6220).
The map column the top strip draws next (0-255, counting up); 1 after a set change ($5FE0).
The map column the bottom strip draws next (counting down from $FF; $5FE5).

Top strip (screen rows 0-5) scroll. Subtracts the speed $6043 from the fine scroll $6044 (0-7); on a borrow moves the six rows and their colour RAM one cell left and draws the new column 39 from the map rows $9250-$9750 at column $6048, each char's colour from $6A22. Map bytes $E0-$EF are loop markers, run through the count/back pairs at $9200 (counter $6046); bytes $90-$DF are skipped (the bottom strip's markers). When the column passes 255 ($6179), scrolls 40 more columns ($617B), then stops and asks for the next set ($5A22 = 1).
Set by $6175 when the top strip's column passes 255; then $60A8 counts 40 more columns before asking for the next set.
Set by $629E when the bottom strip's column passes 0; $61D9 then counts 40 more columns and restarts at $FF.
Columns scrolled since the top strip's map ended ($60D1), up to $28.
Columns scrolled since the bottom strip's map ended ($61FA), up to $28.

Bottom strip (screen rows 19-24) scroll, the mirror of $604A: adds the speed $6043 to the fine scroll $6045; on a carry moves the six rows one cell right and draws column 0 from the map at column $6049, which counts down from $FF. Markers $D0-$DF loop (counter $6047); $90-$CF and $E0-$FF are skipped. After column 0 ($617A) runs 40 more ($617C), then restarts at $FF.
Sets the multicolour bit (4) of $D016.

On odd frames, while $5A2C counts down from 8: the credit band colours from the triple at ($67B9/$67C2)[$5A2C], through $5DCA. The steps run from white (1) at step 8 to $0F/$0C/$0B at step 0, which then stay until the next page change.
On odd frames, while $5A2D counts down from 8: the portrait sprite's $D025, $D026 and $D029 from the triple at ($67FB/$6804)[$5A2D].
Scrolls credit line 1 (screen rows 7 and 8, $4518/$4540) one cell left and puts column $5A2E of buffer $68B3/$68DB at column 39, until it meets the zero at $68DA.
Scrolls credit line 2 (screen rows 16 and 17, $4680/$46A8) one cell right and puts column $5A24 of buffer $6903/$692B at column 0, counting down until it meets the zero at $6903.
The punctuation the credit printer knows, in screen codes: $21 "!", $2E ".", $2C ",", $3F "?", $3A ":"; a match at index n prints glyph $25 + n ($6390).
Width flag for each of $634E: 0 one column, else two; only "?" (1) is wide ($639E).
Sets the print destination (the operand of the STA at $6423): A = high, X = low.

Prints text fragment Y ($653E/$6587) in the 2 x 2 credit font at the destination ($6424/$6425), top half at +0/+1 and bottom half at +40/+41. Text is in screen codes: 1-26 letters, $20 space (one column), $FF end; "! . , ? :" through $634E as glyphs $25-$29 with widths $6353: all but "?" one column; i, j, l one column; other letters two; m ($0D) and w ($17) add a third column from glyph $2A or $2B. Codes $30 and up would be digits as glyph code + $2B, past the 44-glyph table at $B050 (none are used). A glyph is four chars at $B050 + 4 x (glyph - 1).
Operand of LDA $FFFF,Y at $6378: the fragment being printed, set by $6362/$6368 from $653E/$6587.
High byte of the fragment pointer (operand of LDA $FFFF,Y at $6378), written by $6368 from $6587.
Immediate of ADC at $6403: columns the print destination moves after a glyph (1 or 2), written by $6388 and $63DA.
Immediate of LDY at $641C: the position within the fragment, saved by $636D across a glyph's drawing.
Stores A at the print destination + Y (operand set by $6358 and $63FF) and steps Y.
Operand of STA $FFFF,Y at $6423: where the next glyph goes; set by $6358 and advanced by $6405/$640A.
High byte of the print destination (operand of STA $FFFF,Y at $6423), written by $6358 and stepped by $640A on a carry.
Set by $63BC to 1 for m and $FF for w: after the glyph, $640D adds a third column from glyph $2A (m) or $2B (w); cleared by $63D1.
Zeroed by $6375 with $6428; nothing reads it.
Frames left showing each blinking sprite's second image (3 from $645A), for sprite 0 and sprite 5.

Sprite pointers shown while blinking: $FD (sprite 0), $FA (sprite 5).
The sprites that blink: 0 and 5 (index into $47F8).
Frames to the next blink, counted down by $6449; reloaded from $6434.
Current blink period: $50 and $80 as loaded; each reload XORs it with $6436, so it alternates.
$28 and $38: sprite 0's period alternates $50 / $78, sprite 5's $80 / $B8.
$14 as loaded: frames $6439 waits after the end before the blinking starts.

After the end: waits $6438 frames ($14), then for sprites 0 and 5 ($6430) counts each one's period $6432 down; on expiry the period alternates ($50 / $78 for sprite 0, $80 / $B8 for sprite 5, through the XOR $6436) and the sprite shows its second image ($642E: $FD / $FA) for 3 frames ($642A), otherwise its first ($642C: $FC / $FB).

After the end, one step a frame, each disarming its own LDA immediate: (1) $6478: sprite pointers all $20 and colour RAM orange ($5CF0); (2) $648F: screen blank ($5D04); (3) $649C: charset $7800, black colour RAM under the title (rows 7-8, columns 12-25), background colours $6516-$6518, light grey colour RAM at row 18, columns 12-25, the ground chars $6519 at rows 18-19 and $9F at $4732/$4733; (4) $64FE: prints "the  end" ($677A) at row 7, column 12 and loads sprite set 1 ($5DFF).
Immediate of LDA at $6474: 1 until "the end" has been printed ($6512 writes 0); while 0 the step routine does nothing.
Immediate of LDA at $6478: 1 until the sprite pointers and colour RAM are reset ($648B writes 0).
Immediate of LDA at $648F: 1 until the screen is blanked ($6498 writes 0).
Immediate of LDA at $649C: 1 until the ground and colours are drawn ($64FA writes 0).
Background and multicolours for "the end" ($0B $0A $04 into $D021-$D023), copied by $64B9.
